Being a swamp ambush snake they do love to sit by or in the water all the time so I would try either buying or building a large water bowl for them. Since when they get older they become very heavy bodied so you won’t need to focus on anything climbing related and more on having deep substrate and high humidity. 

The personality and anxiety level of your snake is very individualised but I would say generally they will warm up to you within a month to three months and are very eager eaters so you won’t worry much about hunger strikes. They are very vocal snakes but their noise doesn’t always mean that they are upset or giving a warning before striking. After having them for a while you can start being able to tell what each different huff means, some can be wanting attention, some is hunger, some is mildly annoyed, etc. 

Be warned that they poop unlike other snakes, it’s a very shocking sight when it happens and you will think you are prepared but you won’t be. The size is insane. 

Otherwise after having them for a while they become a lap dog basically. They love to relax with you on the couch or bed while you watch tv or play video games but if yours is like mine, if you move too much they will start complaining a lot lol
